metadata.name: liquid-staking-depeg-redemption-run
metadata.description: Single-program liquid-staking depeg + withdrawal-run pressure replay. Scheduled slash at tick 3 drops the exchange rate; redemption demand at tick 4 exceeds the reserve buffer and lands four accounts on the withdrawal queue; tick 5 partial claim settles only the reserve-covered position. Historical inspiration: the 2024 Kelp / rsETH depeg. Honest boundary: single-program pressure replay against the shipped minimal liquid-staking fork, not a cross-protocol contagion claim and not a byte-level reconstruction of any real LST codebase.
